name: zzW1_water_audit

tests.name: the master material was read and exposes named parameters
the water in the level wears M_WL_RealWater, with live values read off a surface
all nine founder views were photographed with the water in frame
at night and dusk the water reads as water -- not a black hole, not a glowing blue sheet

detail.note: GATED ON THE WATER AGAINST ITS OWN FRAME, because every absolute threshold here is a statement about the exposure rather than about the water: the approved night measures 0.9756 crushed by the same fixed-luma test this clause used to gate on, so 0.85 was a bar nothing could clear after dark. A ratio survives the 2.35 EV the exposure opens between noon and midnight. The old absolute figures are kept in the detail so earlier runs stay comparable.
